title: Coupling Does Not Reduce the Auxiliary-Mode Count for $1/|ω|$ Spectra in Passive Lindblad Networks
summary: Representing continuous environments by finitely many Markovian auxiliary modes is fundamental in non-Markovian open quantum systems, yet a critical question remains: at a fixed mode budget, can coherent intermode coupling reduce the spectral approximation error? We prove that intermode coupling offers no advantage when passive, number-conserving Gaussian Lindblad auxiliary networks approximate a $1/|ω|$ spectrum over a finite two-sided frequency band.
